tui.palette.kind_agent.role: type tag beside a command-palette hit
tui.palette.kind_agent.note: One word naming WHAT the hit is, drawn dim to the right of the hit's label: 'command', 'setting', 'session', 'agent', 'team'. Lowercase; it is a tag, never a sentence, and it must not repeat the label. Zero ICU arguments.

tui.palette.no_matches.role: empty state in the command palette
tui.palette.no_matches.note: Shown centred in the palette's list when the typed query matches nothing. A complete standalone sentence fragment in the framework's own phrasing, not an instruction: it states the result, it does not tell the user to retry. Zero ICU arguments.

tui.palette.placeholder.note: Grey placeholder inside the palette's search field, naming what a query can reach: slash commands, settings sections, past conversations, and the names of agents and teams. The ellipsis is a single character, not three dots. Must fit the field at a 60-column terminal, so keep it as one short clause; do not add the key that opens the palette. Zero ICU arguments.
